title: Kaleidoscope
card: Spiral arms of shrinking circles turn slowly around a glowing center.
description: Spiral arms of shrinking, rotating circles turn slowly around the center.

title: Tree Sway
card: Eight branching trees sway in place, leaving a soft, drifting trail.
description: Eight mirrored branching trees sway continuously via Perlin noise, leaving a soft, slow-fading trail behind them.

title: Horizon
card: A geometric sun and grid horizon .
description: Old code doodle for a desktop wallpaper. Move your pointer around for a subtle sense of depth.

title: Grid Veins
card: Organic cave-like veins, rendered with the Marching Squares algorithm.
description: Organic cave-like veins, generated live by a cellular automaton and colored by position in the grid. Click or tap to reseed.

title: Dragon Curve
card: A dragon curve fractal, its color sweeping along its length.
description: A dragon curve fractal, folded from a single line, with color sweeping back and forth along its length.

title: Currents
card: Twin terrain ribbons drift past each other over expanding ripples.
description: Two noise-driven terrain ribbons scroll past each other, linked by faint threads, over slowly expanding ripples.

title: Territory
card: Four colored fronts spread and interlock across the canvas.
description: Four colored fronts spread across the canvas until they interlock. Click, tap, or press any key to reseed.

title: Rotating Squares
card: A ring of nested squares, rotating, and drifting.
description: A ring of nested squares, rotating, and drifting. Move your pointer left or right to change the rotation's speed and direction.

title: Hex Flow
card: A grid of hexagons swirls around a point that follows your cursor.
description: A grid of hexagons flows and swirls around a center point that follows your pointer. Click or tap to send out a ripple.

title: Recursive Tree
card: An organic branching fractal — click to grow a new one.
description: A organic branching fractal. Click or tap to grow a new one.

title: Maze Solver
card: A perfect maze, generated live, then pruned down to its through-paths.
description: A maze generates live, then gets pruned down to its through-paths. Click, tap, or press any key to regenerate.

card: A playable 2048 clone — arrow keys or swipe to slide tiles.
description: Arrow keys to slide tiles, swipe on touch.

title: Minesweeper
description: A playable Minesweeper board. Left-click (or tap) to reveal a cell, right-click to flag one, space to reset.

title: Worley Noise
card: Animated cellular noise, glowing in overlapping tiles.
description: Cellular noise built from drifting, animated feature points. Click, tap, or press any key to reshuffle — toggle the debug view to see the underlying points.
